key_highlights: ASX closed the week lower as traders priced in higher RBA rates, pressuring rate-sensitive sectors (REITs, banks, construction)
Australian banks forecast the biggest house price falls on record, with housing construction expected to follow prices lower
Iron ore market facing a structural shakeout masked by geopolitical conflict; commodity pricing under pressure
EV sales surpassed petrol cars for the first time in Australia; BYD confirms EV tipping point reached
Bathla construction collapse signals broader structural fragility in Australia's construction and housing sector
Oil topped $90 on Iran blockade concerns, supporting energy names but raising inflation risk
Ratings agencies flagged Victoria's soaring state debt as a credit concern
ASIC launched review of whistleblower complaints at Big Four accounting firms, raising governance concerns
Gold producers (Aurum) added high-grade ounces; small-cap miners (Kaoko, Vanadium, Piche) saw notable ASX runners

sectors.trend: Iron ore shakeout underway amid geopolitical distraction; gold producers adding ounces; small-cap miners (Kaoko, Vanadium, Piche, Brightstar, Solstice, Power Minerals) showing relative strength
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure from iron ore softness; gold names (GOLD.AX, WES.AX) and battery-metal plays (VAN.AX, PCH.AX) offer relative outperformance

sectors.trend: Banks forecasting record house price declines; CBA and Westpac under scrutiny for differential pricing of loyal customers; ASIC reviewing Big Four accounting firms
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX face NIM pressure from rate cycle but credit losses may rise with housing downturn; governance risk elevated

sectors.trend: Oil above $90 on Iran blockade; EV adoption accelerating (BYD tipping point, EVs outpacing petrol); VW cutting 50,000 jobs globally
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX benefit from oil strength; transition risk to legacy auto names; EV supply-chain plays gain relevance

sectors.trend: Bathla collapse signals sector-wide fragility; housing construction to follow falling prices; Brisbane waterfront approval lacks affordable housing; Victoria debt flagged by ratings agencies
sectors.implications: CGP.AX, WBC.AX (mortgage book), REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face headwinds; construction names under pressure

sectors.trend: BYD confirms Australia EV tipping point; drones disrupting defence procurement; NVIDIA vs ServiceNow valuation debate; skilled migrant priority for AI workers
sectors.implications: ASX-listed EV/tech exposure limited but thematic tailwind; defence (AWG.AX, STG.AX) benefits from drone procurement shift

sectors.trend: Vietnam dental tourism threat to Australian dentists; cigarette tax political fight; Qantas operational disruption (engine fire)
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, WES.AX (health) relatively insulated; QAN.AX faces operational risk; tobacco tax debate affects consumer staples

key_themes: RBA rate path: market bracing for higher-for-longer, pressuring bonds, REITs, and housing
Housing correction: banks forecasting record price falls; construction sector in structural stress (Bathla)
Commodity bifurcation: iron ore weak, gold and oil strong
EV transition inflection in Australia; legacy auto disruption (VW)
Geopolitical risk premium: Iran blockade, Russia-Ukraine ceasefire, US-Canada trade fallout
Fiscal/credit risk: Victoria debt, ASIC governance review, construction Ponzi dynamics
Labour market: skilled migrant priority for AI and tradies; 6,000 tradie qualification scheme

risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight short-duration bonds; reduce REIT and construction exposure; favour dividend-paying large caps

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market correction and construction sector contagion
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight CGP.AX, building materials; monitor bank NPL trends; favour defensive consumer staples

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil spike above $90 / Iran blockade / inflation reacceleration
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure via WDS.AX, WLE.AX; monitor CPI trajectory; consider AUD/USD short if inflation forces RBA hawkishness

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore demand shakeout / China slowdown
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify away from pure iron ore (RIO.AX, FMG.AX) toward gold (GOLD.AX) and copper exposure

risk_assessment.risk_factor: State fiscal deterioration (Victoria debt) and credit downgrades
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor state bond spreads; reduce exposure to Victorian REITs and infrastructure

risk_assessment.risk_factor: El Nino / cyclone risk to infrastructure and agriculture
risk_assessment.mitigation: Review insurance coverage; monitor SUG.AX, WBC.AX (agri lending) for weather-related credit stress
Maintain 10-15% cash allocation; favour domestic defensive equities

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and battery-metal miners amid iron ore weakness and EV demand surge
opportunities.rationale: Gold ounces expanding (Aurum), EV tipping point confirmed by BYD, small-cap miners showing relative strength

opportunities.recommendation: Add energy exposure on oil above $90
opportunities.rationale: Iran blockade supports sustained oil premium; WDS and WLE benefit from higher realised prices

opportunities.recommendation: Favour large-cap banks on dividend yield despite housing headwinds
opportunities.rationale: CBA, NAB offer 6%+ yields; rate environment supports NIM; housing correction is gradual not abrupt

opportunities.recommendation: Defence and drone-related equities on procurement shift
opportunities.rationale: Cheap drones upending defence business model; Australian government increasing defence spend

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce REIT and construction exposure ahead of rate hikes and housing correction
defensive_moves.rationale: ASX lower on rate fears; banks forecast record house price falls; Bathla collapse signals sector fragility

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD/USD and commodity-linked equities on geopolitical/inflation risk
defensive_moves.rationale: Oil spike, Iran blockade, and US-Canada trade fallout create volatility; AUD may weaken on inflation-driven RBA hawkishness

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain 10-15% cash or short-duration bond allocation
defensive_moves.rationale: Elevated uncertainty from rates, housing, geopolitics; bull case returning but fragile

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure over 1-3 months as RBA rate expectations firm, housing data deteriorates, and oil-driven inflation keeps the RBA hawkish. Iron ore weakness caps mining multiples. Gold and energy provide relative outperformance. Volatility elevated on geopolitical headlines.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautiously constructive: EV transition and defence spending create structural tailwinds; housing correction, while painful, is a normalisation. Gold and battery metals benefit from energy transition. Key risk is a sharper-than-expected housing downturn triggering credit stress in banks and construction. Canada outperforming Australia on per-capita growth is a structural concern.

GOLD.AX, WES.AX production and gold price

El Nino / cyclone season impact on Qld and NT infrastructure
